translation.name: Jamaw ta Marbinto: Kabarre ta Gala ɗo bi ka Iisa Masi iŋ daŋla

book.name: Hebru
book.title: Hebru Maktumne taat ŋu siirtu ɗo gee ku Hebru

content: Goye kaak Buŋ rakiyo
Elguwoŋ ziŋkiko ar siŋta kuuk tacco rakki.
Dakoŋ rawtenno obe ka martir. Ka seener, iŋ obe ka martir-ak, gee daarin̰ ob *ɗubal ku Buŋdi ho ŋu ibingigɗo.
Pakiroŋ ɗo gee kuuk ŋu obtu daŋaayne ho ginoŋ ar kuŋko oki, ŋu obiŋko iŋ ŋuura. Pakiroŋ ɗo gee kuuk ŋu taaɓiyaagu, ho kuŋ oki, ginoŋ ar ŋu taaɓiyaako.

Gee okin̰co, illa ŋuu bere horoomin ɗo obindi. Ɗo ŋuur kuuk ob gay, nu kaawaaco, illa ŋuu karmiyin̰ obin̰co, ŋuu kokinenno kara. Yampa, Buŋ asaaco ɗukume seriin ɗo gee okin̰co kuuk ɓaaƴa mun̰jam ho ɗo ŋuur kuuk kokina daaɗi wal miday kara.
Ɗo goyiŋko, dakoŋ elenno gurus aale. Hamdiyoŋ iŋ maan kaak ku gintu di. Asaan Buŋ meen̰ji kaaw aman : « Nu rasaacinno keejiŋ ho nu newsaajinno kop tak-tak. »
Ɗo saan taar-an ko, nii kaawe bal kolaw aman :

content.text: Gem iŋ odinay seer ar kunto di,

content: Pakron̰co ɗo aginduwko kuuk gaarkon kaaw ta Buŋdi. Taloŋ ja maman ŋu goytu nam ŋu mattu ho icon imaan tan̰co.
Iisa Masi makaaɗo tak-tak, wala diŋka, wala wiktin taat bire, wala taat yaa ase neginda.

Yaman, dakoŋ rasenno ziŋkiko ŋuuko jagiŋko iŋ ay ɓilde kaak arro iŋ imaanko. Ka seener gay, maan kaak samaan-ak, illa gelbinte yaa ɗeŋre iŋ barkin ta Buŋdi. Yampa, ŋu ɗeŋraaɗo iŋ *gaanuun kaak kaawa ɗo bi ka teendi. Gaanuun ar ŋaar-aŋ bal gaayin̰co iŋ maanna ŋuur kuuk aaɗaaga.
Ka seener, gi gin wer ka satkiner. Kar gay, maan kaak ŋu bertu *satkin ɗo wer-ak, gay satkiner ku *Yuudinnar ginno botol taat ŋuu teen̰ji.
Ya taɓ gay, baar ku mallel kuuk ŋu bertu satkin ɗo bi ka zunuubinnico-ak, mee satkiner kaak tatik iyiig ɗo *wer kaak cawar. Kar kumco gay, ŋu eriig kara ɗo kalaaner.
Ampaa ko, Iisa oki mattu kara min geeger ka Zeruzaleem a gee yaa kuuniye *cawar iŋ baar ku meen̰ji.
Ansi-ak, ginte oki amilinte kara ɗo wer kaak ŋa goyiyo ho ooyinteŋ ƴile kaak gee yaate ƴilinte ar ŋaara.
Asaan diŋ gi ginno wer ka goyindi kaak yaa taaye doo. Kar gay, gi bariya ka neginda.
Iŋ Iisa Masi ko, gi abdiyiy Buŋ ho gi oziliy siŋji. Ampa-ak, gi bera doo satkin ta oziliikar ɗo Buŋdi.
Dakoŋ rawtenno gine ka selliŋkaw ho iŋ gaay ta ziŋkiko. Asaan satkinkan ŋuur-aŋ kat aawaaji gala ɗo Buŋdi.
Karmiyoŋ aginduwko ho onoŋ uŋco. Ka seener, ŋuur di tala kaako doo ho neginda Buŋ asa indin̰co. Ginoŋ a ŋuu gaasin riyco iŋ galal bal niize. Yampa, ya ŋu niizaw-ak, kuu uce maala.
Inde ka Buŋdi
Gem kol siŋtay, indiguwonni Buŋ. Ni iban ɗo kaƴni kadar gelbinni *cawar, asaan ɗo goyinni, ni ic niyin taat nii ginguwe taat samaane ay wiktine.
Maan kaak paka nu rakiy minninko-ak, illa kuudu inde Buŋ a ŋaadu pile botol naako yeepe koɗok.
Buŋ kaak iya aapiye nooyig *Rabbinte Iisa min ɗo muuti ho ŋa gintu gay gooƴindi kaak tatiko. Iŋ baariy kuuk min̰e, ŋa ɗuuniit jamaw taat Buŋ obtu iŋ gee ho ta ɗukumaaɗo tak-tak.
Buŋ yaako bere gudurre kuu gine ay riy taat kuuniy iŋ niyiney. Iŋ botol ta Iisa Masi, ŋaate gaayinte gii necin̰ ay maan kaak ŋa rakiyo. Locin di *darjine elgin iŋ elgina ! *Aamin.
Ooy ta ba aaro
Gem kol siŋtay, kaawin kuuk nu n̰aamiiko a naako iskiŋko-aŋ, oboŋ samaane ɗo aditko iŋ subirraw. Asaan maktumner-an, taar kaawinti sooɗ di.
Nu minaako kadar siŋte Timote, ŋu imilig min daŋaayne. Ya ŋa as koɗok-ak, niiko ɓaawe seertini.
Ooyon̰co dakina ɗo aginduwko okin̰co ho ɗo gee ku Buŋdi okin̰co. Ŋuur kuuk goy Itali oki ooyko dakina.
Barkin ta Buŋdi yaa goye iŋ kuŋko okiŋko ! Nu ooyko dakina.
